capabilities: Edit tables via a floating toolbar or right-click menu (insert, move, align, sort)
Edit tables in an Excel-like grid editor with drag-to-select and apply-to-source
Render merged cells (rowspan/colspan) in Reading view and Live Preview
Paste tables from Excel or web clipboard as Markdown
extras: Not compatible with Table Extended at runtime: the README warns that both plugins hook the same parser and one should be disabled. Interface is available in English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: Combines the most useful pieces of three popular table plugins into a single, modern UI
motivation: To combine the most useful pieces of three popular table plugins into a single, modern UI.
problem: Obsidian's tables have no merged-cell support, no visual grid editing, and lack quick toolbar actions for restructuring rows and columns.

relations.evidence: GUI shortcuts (insert / delete / move row & column, alignment) — replaces Advanced Tables
Visual grid editor with drag-to-select and merged-cell support — replaces Markdown Table Editor
Merged cells rendered in both Reading view and Live Preview, fully compatible with Table Extended / MultiMarkdown syntax — replaces Table Extended

summary: Markdown table toolkit with a floating toolbar, Excel-like grid editor, and merged-cell support using MultiMarkdown ^^ / || syntax.
